item.title: Version 3.5.0
item.description: - **Meet Ross:** the Tutor has a name. Ask for a hint and Ross asks for your try first, then gives one hint or one step at a time; Show the solution ends with a similar problem to try. - **What Ross knows:** a profile for each course in Progress — topics, how many hints you usually need, mistakes that keep coming back, and how you like to learn. Edit, hide or clear any of it, or switch it off. - **Taught for the subject:** each course gets a subject (picked from its code, changeable in one tap) that shapes Ross's help, the quiz questions and the study guide. - **How sure are you:** quizzes ask Sure / Think so / Guess before the answer; Progress shows how sure versus how right, and the "sure but wrong" ones. - **Missed questions come back:** later in the same quiz, and the next day as flashcards. - **Better study guides:** worked example, then one to finish, then one to do yourself; cover-and-recall questions; a page of your own mistakes; space to write when printed. Choose the length, split into titled parts, and pick what goes in. - **Better quiz questions:** broken or giveaway questions are dropped. - **Grades:** score each item (Exam 1, 42/50), use the syllabus's own letter scale and "drop lowest", see what you need on what's left, and enter a score when you mark work done. - **Reading:** each open book gets its own tab, with Ask about the page you're on, Highlights and Notes beside it. - **Notes:** a sidebar with Pinned, Recent, courses, tags and Archive; a toolbar with labels; and a small format bar over selected text. - **Snippets:** write emails right in Rostrum — drag snippets in, fill the blanks with Tab, and Copy for email keeps bold, lists and links in Gmail, Outlook and iCloud Mail. - **Today and Insights:** Edit to remove, resize, reorder or add widgets. - **Study:** a cleaner look, browser-style tabs, and your sources grouped by Notes, Slides, Textbook and Handouts. - **Tutor tools:** ask Ross for a formula sheet, flashcards, a note, a study plan or a study guide, and it makes it. - **What's new:** the "Rostrum was updated" card shows each change in full. - **Assistant:** works with GPT-5.6 Luna again.
